sampling: one random sample of the base population per panel (true proportions); red drawn first, blue on top

1809_2_SIMFLUX.rule: modulation error < 0.1 (own pattern, SMLM per-frame intensities at the SMLM position; the SIMFLUX input filter)
1809_2_SIMFLUX.base: SMLM fits accepted by the baseline (chi^2 <= 4 x ROI^2 on the 8 x 8 px ROI, smlm.npy) in the crop
1809_2_SIMFLUX.isolation: no other detection of either method within 3.0 px (325 nm) in the same window (union list; own counterpart within 1 px of the other method not counted)

1809_2_SIMCODE.rule: modulation error < 0.1 (own pattern, pass-1 intensities at the pass-1 head position)
1809_2_SIMCODE.base: detections p >= 0.63 in the crop (no precision cut), finite positive intensities
1809_2_SIMCODE.isolation: no other detection of either method within 3.0 px (325 nm) in the same window (union list; own counterpart within 1 px of the other method not counted)
